# bubbletea has no way back to the thread it draws on (#272), so a query whose
# fetch waits is refused, at the call that waits. One whose fetch answers at
# once builds.

! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out waits.sngl
stderr 'waits.sngl:10:10: this call blocks and bubbletea has no way to run anything back on the thread it draws on'

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out at_once.sngl
exists out/model.go

-- waits.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import . "sngl:ui"
import go "sngl:language/go"

#[go.native("time", "time.Sleep")]
#[go.async]
func sleep(ns int)

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    sleep(1000)
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component detail node {
    var length option[int] = null
    async.query(on="mew", fetch=lookup, :value=length)
    text(value=length != null ? "{length}" : "-")
}

window {
    detail
}
-- at_once.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import . "sngl:ui"

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component detail node {
    var length option[int] = null
    async.query(on="mew", fetch=lookup, :value=length)
    text(value=length != null ? "{length}" : "-")
}

window {
    detail
}
